- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.10) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next period.  
- After a sharp price spike (≥ 5% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +2% above peak or use 3-period moving average to smooth.  
- If sentiment is consistently negative (≤ -0.15) over 5+ days, model underestimates; add 1–2% to forecast to counteract mean reversion bias.  
- Model frequently overreacts to short-term sentiment swings; apply 2-period lag smoothing to reduce noise-driven overcorrection.  
- For 30-day horizon, if true outcome deviates > 2% from 14-day moving average, adjust forecast toward historical mean of last 18 days.
